name: Beijing Tongyizhong New Material Technology Corporation
summary: Beijing Tongyizhong New Material Technology Corporation, a Chinese company with its headquarters in Beijing, focuses on the innovation, manufacturing, and distribution of ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) fibers and their associated composite materials. The company's offerings include high-modulus polyethylene (HMPE) fibers suitable for a wide array of uses, such as specialized ropes and netting, protective gloves, ballistic applications, cut-resistant items, fishing lines, and pre-colored fiber solutions. They also produce various advanced textiles, including soft and hard ballistic fabrics, as well as materials engineered for resistance against cuts and stabs. Additionally, their product range encompasses complete protective gear like ballistic helmets, armor plates, vehicle reinforcement systems, defensive shields, explosion-proof blankets, and personal body armor. Complementary products include cut-resistant bags, innovative cool-touch fabrics, high-performance ropes, diverse fishery-related goods, and cut-protective apparel. This enterprise was founded in 1999.
